0022600027.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (8-1, 1st in the Atlantic and in the East, with a five-game winning streak and a 4-0 road record) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4, 6th in the East and 2 games back in the Central, having lost their last two) for the 76ers' 10th game of the season. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Adem Bona is day-to-day with a back sprain and a game-time decision, while Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and has Jarrett Allen, Peyton Watson and Tyrese Proctor listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 114-106 win in Philadelphia on October 22, and they were swept 0-4 by Cleveland in the 2025-26 season.
